violations.description: General employee practices. — --Food employee observed using tobacco outside of designated area. -Ashtrays behind the bar with cigarette butts.

Preventing contamination during storage. — --Food item was not properly protected from potential contamination. -Bacon bits and croutons on the salad bar are not covered. Container of meat in the walk in cooler not covered.
Preventing contamination by consumers. — --Consumer self-service sign was not posted where needed or as required. -No sign on the salad bar telling customers to use a clean plate.

Date marking and disposition of ready-to-eat potentially hazardous food. — --Refrigerated, ready-to-eat potentially hazardous food was not properly date marked. -Containers in the walk in cooler not date marked.
Ventilation hood systems - Design and construction. — --Ventilation hood system was not designed and/or maintained properly. -Vent hood unable to keep up. Staining the walls and ceiling.
Cleaning frequency of equipment and utensils. — --Nonfood contact surface was not cleaned as frequently as required. -Top and sides of the ice machine need cleaned.
Storage of cleaned equipment and utensils. — --Clean equipment/utensil was not covered or inverted during storage. -Plates and bowls on the salad bar are not inverted or covered.
Prep/vegetable sink. — --Designated prep sink was not provided or not used for food items requiring washing/soaking.

Cleaning and maintenance of floors, walls and ceilings. — --Physical facilities (e.g. floors, walls, ceiling etc…) were not clean or not cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. -Facility floors, walls, and ceiling need cleaned.--Physical facilities (e.g. floors, walls, ceiling etc…)were not maintained in good repair. -Floors in the back and wall in the dishwashing area in need of repair.

Heating, ventilation, and air conditioning. — --Mechanical ventilation was not sufficient to keep rooms free of excessive heat, condensation, vapors, smoke, fumes or obnoxious odors. -Can smell cigarette smoke.
